name: agent-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow or any delegated plan, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time. Based on johnnyvizz/claude-kit savvy-progress.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: on animates the crabs and the bar on desktop and spins running work in the terminal; off keeps them still
